algebraic_translation.scope: preferred-sector/dual-interface convention used by the frozen C10 lineage

finite_time_consistency.integrated_statement: Starting from I_khr(tau_on)=0, |I_khr(tau)-0| <= (C_theta+C_B) k^2 Delta_tau on every fixed finite regular in-EFT interval.
finite_time_consistency.consequence: The selected zero-charge branch remains I_khr=O(k^2) in the regular superhorizon limit; exact zero at finite k is neither required nor implied.

initial_data_geometry.effect: The declared boundary removes one independent neutral-charge amplitude from the adiabatic initial-condition subspace, i.e. selects a codimension-one surface in the neutral charge direction.
initial_data_geometry.does_not_remove_theory_mode: Solutions with nonzero I_khr remain allowed and constitute a distinct charge/isocurvature initial-condition sector of the theory.
initial_data_geometry.theta_status: theta_khr is not fixed by I_khr=0 and must be determined together with ordinary radiation/matter variables and completed-U1 algebraic metric constraints by the next coupled growing/decaying-mode solve.

consistency_with_C10_63.numerical_fact: The frozen pure-charge transfer approaches unity with low-k p_Q>2.07 while regular velocity-to-charge leakage scales with p_U about 2.
consistency_with_C10_63.interpretation: This supports treating I_khr as a genuine independent boundary datum rather than assuming finite-time EFT evolution automatically selects I_khr=0.

architecture_decision.adiabatic_branch: Use I_khr(tau_on)=0 as an explicit declared pre-EFT boundary condition when constructing the minimal adiabatic growing mode.
architecture_decision.charge_isocurvature_branch: Retain nonzero-I_khr initial data as a separate sector for later phenomenological constraints; do not silently project it out of the theory.
architecture_decision.label: BOUNDARY_PRESCRIPTION_NOT_DYNAMICAL_MECHANISM

next_gate: C10.65: freeze and implement the completed-U1 photon+baryon+massless-UR dual-interface superhorizon growing/decaying-mode system using I_khr(tau_on)=0 only for the adiabatic branch, solve theta_khr rather than prescribing it, and verify algebraic constraint regularity plus recovery of a unique growing adiabatic direction modulo overall normalization.
non_claims: not a derivation of I_khr=0 from the microscopic UV theory
not a proof of naturalness or radiative stability
not a proof that charge is absent from the full theory
not a determination of theta_khr or the full adiabatic growing eigenvector
not a completed photon+baryon+UR Boltzmann integration
